only WRONG password submissions count toward the per-IP limit and the per-email budget; a correct password is refunded once checked; a blocked one is never checked or refunded

new-browser sign-in notice: a completed sign-in from a browser not trusted for that email mails the user time, IP and browser; trusted browsers get none (tests/test_signin_notice.py; owner received one live 2026-10-10)

app sign-in turns itself off without a mail provider; allowed_emails compared case-insensitively on every app path; set-password validates the base URL before issuing a token; 429 alerts worded 'quota used up or rate-limited' (tests/test_signin_review_fixes.py, tests/test_alerts.py)
